name: precision_formatting
description: Insert a Python body with automatic preparation and validation. The agent supplies logic; the tool preserves the signature and adds enclosing indentation.

steps.purpose: Inspect the exact contract and target selection. Supply body statements only, no def/signature.
Read the target. In a coding cell use read_file and its read_ref; in standalone MCP inspect/call files.text.read and use source_sha256.

Provide the complete body, target and observed version. Preparation removes a common margin, parses the body, adds enclosing indentation and compiles the whole candidate automatically. commit=false previews; commit=true performs the guarded write.
Read committed bytes back and run authorized acceptance checks. A preview or successful parse alone is not completion.

optional_body_diagnostics.purpose: Inspect the pure formatter if a separate body check is useful.
Returns the prepared body, or a line-specific syntax error. Pass returned text to method.fill as logic without adding spaces or a wrapper.

body_rules: Sequential body-level statements start at column 0. Only nested suites are indented.
A common margin is removable; inconsistent internal indentation needs the agent to correct its intended nesting.
Never strip every line: that changes conditionals and loops.
limits: This recipe is guidance data, not an executable macro. A body parse does not prove function-context validity or application behavior. Whole-file compilation and acceptance checks remain required.
